name: Leannán Sidhe
gmNotes: A Leannán Sidhe is a Fey-trained role: a Takeling trained for seduction, artistic inspiration, sexuality, bonding, and attachment research. It is a role, training pattern, or social identity — not a biological Species; the individual's Species is recorded separately. Treat their work as research with real emotional stakes. Archetypes are descriptive and grant no automatic mechanics.
description: A muse of the Fair Folk — beautiful, magnetic, and dangerous to love. A Leannán Sidhe inspires artists, lovers, and dreamers, and takes something in return, and the songs written about them are never quite the whole story. To catch their eye is a gift; to keep it is another matter.
